items.prompt:
A feedback is when a change causes a response that
A) increases or decreases it
B) does nothing
C) deletes the Earth
D) only adds water

steps: Feedbacks increase or decrease a change.

items.prompt:
In a positive feedback, a change leads to ____ of that change.
A) more
B) less
C) none
D) the opposite

Earth's four interacting systems include the geosphere, hydrosphere, biosphere, and
A) atmosphere
B) sun
C) moon
D) galaxy

Melting ice exposing darker surface that absorbs more sunlight is a
A) positive feedback
B) negative feedback
C) no feedback
D) chemical reaction

steps: More melting leads to more warming and melting.

items.prompt:
A negative feedback
A) reduces the original change
B) amplifies the change
C) has no effect
D) only warms things

Melting permafrost releasing warming gases that melt more permafrost involves the
A) geosphere and atmosphere
B) only the biosphere
C) only the hydrosphere
D) no systems

steps: Melting ground releases gases into the air.

items.prompt:
Warmer air evaporating more water vapor that traps more heat is a
A) positive feedback that speeds warming
B) negative feedback that cools
C) no feedback
D) one-time event
items.answer: A) positive feedback that speeds warming

steps: More vapor traps more heat, a positive feedback.

items.prompt:
Plants holding soil, slowing erosion, letting more plants grow is a feedback that
A) stabilizes the surface
B) destroys the surface
C) has no effect
D) only speeds erosion

steps: Plants and soil form a stabilizing feedback.
